app.name: Coverly ROMs
app.tagline: Find and add the missing cover art in your ROMs
app.crashed: Something went wrong in the app.

start.dropHint: Or drop a folder or SD card here.
start.noVolumes: No drives or SD cards found.
start.suggestSystemFolders: Looks like a folder organised by system

organizeOffer.title: This folder doesn't follow a known layout
organizeOffer.body: It holds {roms} files that look like ROMs. Coverly can propose one folder per system; nothing moves until you confirm.
organizeOffer.broadRoot: This is a broad personal folder; only files that look like ROMs are proposed.
organizeOffer.truncated: More than {count} files; all of them are checked when organising.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reopen: Reopen the library to apply these changes.

notice.migrated: Your earlier library settings were moved into the new settings file.
notice.reset-corrupt: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults are in use. The old file was kept: {backup}
notice.fixed: Some settings were not valid and went back to their defaults ({fields}). A copy of the file was kept: {backup}
notice.future-version: These settings were saved by a newer version; what this version does not know is ignored. A copy was kept: {backup}

general.checkUpdates: Check for updates when the app starts

library.ignoredDirsHint: One folder name per line. They are skipped at any depth.
library.ignoredExtsHint: Comma-separated, without dots. Files with these extensions are never taken as ROMs.
library.followSymlinksHint: Art is never written outside the library folder: ROMs in a linked folder that points elsewhere are listed, but their art is skipped with an error.

art.singleSlotHint: Anbernic, GarlicOS, Onion and MinUI show one image per game.
art.maxSizeHint: Leave empty to use the layout's own limit.

matching.languagesHint: Two-letter codes, comma-separated (en, es, fr…). Used to break ties.

sources.needsKey: Store an API key below to turn it on
sources.credentialsHint: Stored in the system keychain, never in the settings file, and never shown again.

check.rate-limited: The server asks to wait; try again later.
check.unavailable: The server could not check it now.

network.proxyHint: System uses the standard HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY variables.
network.clearBody: The downloaded art and source lists are deleted. Manual matches and undo history are kept.

safety.backup: Back up files before replacing them
safety.backupHint: Always on: Undo needs the backups.
safety.backupDirHint: Empty: the app's own folder. Changing it hides the jobs kept in the previous folder from Undo.
safety.appleDouble: Delete macOS ._ files on removable drives

advanced.customDirHint: Empty: the profiles folder inside the settings folder.
advanced.resetBody: Every setting goes back to its default. Recent libraries are kept and a copy of the current settings is saved.

organize.title: Organise
organize.nestInRoms: Put the system folders inside the layout's ROMs folder
organize.modeAuto: Move on the same drive, copy otherwise
organize.downloadDats: Download game catalogues to identify ROMs by their contents
organize.advancedHint: Thresholds and lists are edited in Advanced (settings file).

about.license: Licence: AGPL-3.0-only. Coverly ROMs is free software; its name and logo are trademarks (see Trademarks).
about.noTelemetry: No telemetry: Coverly ROMs only contacts the art sources you enable and, unless you turn it off, the update server.

update.upToDate: Coverly ROMs is up to date ({version}).
update.waitingForJob: The update is downloaded. It will be installed when the fill job finishes.
update.ready: Version {version} is installed. Restart Coverly ROMs to use it.
update.restartAfterJob: Restart after the fill job finishes.
update.channelHint: Beta gets new versions first; they may have more bugs.

library.empty: No ROMs found in this folder.
library.emptyHint: Check that you picked the SD card or its ROMs folder. Warnings: {n}.
library.noMatch: No ROMs match the search and filters.

errors.not-a-folder: This is a file, not a folder: {detail}
errors.unreadable: Coverly ROMs cannot read {detail}. Check its permissions.
errors.no-profile: No known layout was found in {detail}. Pick the SD card root or its ROMs folder.
errors.stale-library: The library was reopened. Try again.
errors.unknown-entry: This ROM is no longer in the library.
errors.art-missing: There is no image for this ROM.
errors.outside-library: This image is outside the library and was not opened.
errors.art-too-large: This image is too large to show.
errors.settings: The settings could not be saved: {detail}
errors.job-running: A fill job is running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
errors.stale-job: That fill job was replaced by a newer one.
errors.network: The art source could not be reached: {detail}
errors.bad-image: This file is not a usable image: {detail}
errors.write-denied: Coverly ROMs cannot write to the library (read-only or no permission): {detail}
errors.name-invalid: This file name is not valid on SD cards: {detail}
errors.volume-gone: The library volume was removed or is no longer reachable: {detail}
errors.keychain-unavailable: This system has no credential store (keychain) Coverly ROMs can use.
errors.keychain-locked: The keychain is locked. Unlock it and try again.
errors.update-offline: Could not reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.update-signature: The downloaded update failed its signature check and was NOT installed. Nothing was changed.
errors.update-unavailable: No update was found for this channel and system: none is published yet, or the update server could not provide it.
errors.update-no-key: This build cannot update itself. Download new versions from the Releases page.
errors.update-failed: The update could not be installed: {detail}
errors.no-plan: That organise plan is no longer kept. Plan again.
errors.later-jobs: Newer jobs changed files under this folder ({detail}). Undo them too, or keep this organisation.
errors.no-space: There is not enough free space for this copy (needed/free bytes: {detail}).

field.order: This must not be higher than the auto-accept threshold.
field.not-absolute: Use a full path (starting with / or a drive letter).

drawer.identifyHint: Look this ROM up in the game databases.
drawer.offline: Offline: identified by its file name only.
drawer.searchUpdated: Art updated. This ROM now matches “{name}”.
drawer.replaceConfirm: Use “{name}”? The current image is backed up and Undo brings it back. The file keeps the ROM's name.
drawer.noCandidates: No images found for this ROM.
drawer.removeConfirm: Remove this image? It is backed up and Undo brings it back.
drawer.busy: A fill job is running: art changes wait until it ends.
drawer.mediaUpdated: {media} updated. Undo it from Jobs if needed.
drawer.mediaRemoved: {media} removed. Undo it from Jobs if needed.
drawer.replaceShort: The current image is backed up and Undo brings it back.

fill.title: Fill missing art

strategyHint.rom-region: Prefers the ROM's own region, then the order below.
strategyHint.priority: Prefers the first source, then the order below.
strategyHint.popularity: Prefers the image with the most SteamGridDB votes; without votes, the variant most sources and art types agree on; then source priority.

fill.popularityNoKey: SteamGridDB is not ready, so votes are not used: add a key in Settings → Sources.

overwrite.title: Existing art
overwrite.backup: Also replace existing art (with a backup)
overwrite.backupHint: Replaced images are kept in the app's data folder and come back with Undo.
overwrite.askHint: Your settings ask every time: choose one to continue.

fill.gamelist: gamelist.xml in each system folder is updated too (backed up first; Undo restores it).
fill.pausedHint: The dry run paused. Resume it when the connection is back.

pause.rate-limit: Paused: the art server is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and resume.
pause.offline: Paused: no connection to the art server. Resume when you are back online.
pause.volume: Paused: the SD card is full, read-only or was removed. Fix it and resume.

jobs.title: Jobs

state.planned: Dry run ready: nothing written yet.

error.name-invalid: Name not valid on SD cards

jobs.undoConfirm: Undo the last job? Written images are removed and replaced ones restored; images you changed since are kept.

organizeUndo.label: Undo the organisation of {date}
organizeUndo.confirm: Undo this organisation? The files go back where they were; files you changed since stay where they are.

jobs.undone: Undone: {removed} removed, {restored} restored, {kept} kept because you changed them.

review.title: Review doubtful matches
review.variantNote: The best image is a beta, prototype, hack or unlicensed variant: check it before writing.
review.keys: Keys: ← → move · 1–9 choose · Enter accept · S skip · A accept all remaining · Esc back

reason.release: a release beats betas, prototypes and hacks.
reason.consensus: most sources and art types agree on it ({count}; next {next}).
reason.tie: equal in every way; first by name.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Missing art per system, and exports of the audit and the last fill job.

profiles.hint: Built-in layouts cannot be changed; duplicate one to adapt it. Custom layouts are saved as files in the profiles folder.
profiles.deleteBody: The profile file is deleted. Libraries opened with it fall back to detection.
profiles.name: Name

errors.slotsOrder: Either every slot template uses {rel_dir} or none does.
errors.slotsRequired: Turn on at least one slot.

why.extensionShared: .{ext} extension, shared by several systems; {system} is likely
why.extensionContradicted: .{ext} extension of {system}, but the header doesn't match
why.name: The name resembles {name} ({system})

left.recent: Changed moments ago; it may still be downloading
left.bios: BIOS: belongs in the device's BIOS folder
left.multiGameArchive: Archive with several games; extract it first
left.symlink: Symbolic link; left as it is
left.setOutsideFolder: Some of its files are outside this folder
left.ambiguousCompanion: Belongs to several ROMs; unclear which to follow
left.collisionSet: Another game already uses those names in the target
left.title: Staying where they are

organize.summary: ROMs: {roms} · Systems: {systems} · To review: {review} · Staying put: {left}
organize.dryRunHint: This is a proposal. Nothing has moved yet.

target.label: Target

target.mismatch: The target uses {profile}; new folders won't show up on that system.

mode.label: Mode
mode.moveDisabled: Can't move: the source folder is read-only.

review.title: To review
review.hint: Choose each file's system, or leave it where it is.

organize.renamed: Will be saved as {name} because a different file already exists
organize.renamedShort: Name shortened to fit the path length limit
organize.multiRomZip: Holds {count} ROMs; the console will load only the first.
organize.noFolderOnDevice: {layout} has no folder for {system}; {folder} will be created.
organize.encrypted: Encrypted; some emulators can't load it
organize.copiedNotRemoved: Copied; the original couldn't be removed
organize.stopped: Stopped. What was already organised stays; Undo puts it back.

skipped.collision-set: Skipped: another game already uses those names

organize.undone: Restored: {restored} · Left alone because they changed: {modified}
